name: Claude Code
why: The AI that does the work, on your own Claude plan.

win32.check: if (-not ((Test-Path "$env:ProgramFiles/Git/bin/bash.exe") -or (Get-Command git -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue))) { exit 1 }; if (-not (Get-Command claude -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue)) { exit 1 }; claude --version; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { exit 1 }
install: if (-not ((Test-Path "$env:ProgramFiles/Git/bin/bash.exe") -or (Get-Command git -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue))) { winget install --id Git.Git --exact --source winget --accept-source-agreements --accept-package-agreements --silent; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { exit 1 } }
